description: Compare two OpenAPI specifications and say which changes BREAK a client that already exists - which is the question you actually ask before deploying, and the one a colour diff does not answer. Tells apart pairs that look identical in a diff: adding an OPTIONAL parameter breaks nothing, adding a REQUIRED one does; ADDING an enum value is safe, REMOVING one is not; dropping a query parameter is ignored, dropping a path one changes the URL. Every finding says why.

after.description: The one you want to publish

name: api_breaking_changes
